statements.statement: Finding c03b79af-b606-4868-8e76-3b54bcd1b67c (SQL Injection in 'q' Parameter (/sqli/search)) is a Critical confirmed error-based SQL injection vulnerability in the q parameter that returns database syntax details or HTTP 500 responses.

Finding 585303cd-39a7-4fe3-91b4-798a162d420a (Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in 'name' Parameter (/ssti/render)) is a Medium confirmed reflected XSS vulnerability where the name parameter reflects unescaped executable script markup into a text/html response.

statements.statement: Finding 585303cd-39a7-4fe3-91b4-798a162d420a, Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in 'name' Parameter (/ssti/render), is confirmed with Medium severity: the name query parameter reflects unescaped executable <script> HTML markup into a text/html response DOM.
